lockup.summary: Directors, officers and holders of nearly all shares agreed not to sell for 180 days after the prospectus date. The underwriters can allow exceptions with written consent, and other customary exceptions apply.

what: It is a drug developer testing RTN-001, a once-daily pill meant to treat high blood pressure and other heart diseases.
proceeds: It plans to use about $18 million to finish a Phase 2b trial of RTN-001 and about $10 million to prepare for a Phase 3 trial. The rest goes to general business costs.
risks: The company is young, has lost money since it began, expects more losses, and may never make a profit.
If the company cannot continue as a going concern, investors would likely lose all or part of their money.
The company needs a lot more money, and failing to raise it could force it to delay or stop its programs.
The company must grow its organization and may struggle to manage that growth well.
The company relies on its managers and scientists, and losing them or failing to hire more would hurt the business.
risks_note: The first 5 risk factors, summarised by AI.
